why_ai: LLMs already replace much microtask labelling, and task distribution is simple software with no licence.
why_clarity: Post, assign, submit and pay recur millions of times, though quality disputes resist objective checks.
why_digital: Tasks, submissions and payments flow online to a globally distributed workforce.

why_ai: Who bears broken-task cost is a contested platform policy choice, not a computation.
why_clarity: Fairness of allocating blame among worker, requester and platform has no agreed standard.
why_digital: Disputes, rejections and payments are platform records handled entirely online.

why_ai: Confusion signals are already recorded and LLMs readily flag ambiguous instructions before launch.
why_clarity: Split answers and worker questions reveal bad instructions, but only after a batch runs.
why_digital: Instructions and response data are text on the platform.

why_ai: Realised hourly rate is arithmetic over task timing data the platform already holds.
why_clarity: Price divided by measured completion time gives an exact, instantly checkable rate.
why_digital: Prices and timings are platform data shown to requesters on screen.

why_ai: Purchasable payout rails under money-transmission rules; any capable provider will do.
why_clarity: A payout either arrives in full and on time or it does not.
why_digital: Cross-border micropayments move entirely through digital payout rails.

why_ai: Rejection rates and payment speed sit in the database, so ratings are straightforward computation.
why_clarity: Requester metrics are countable, though which ones signal bad behaviour needs validation.
why_digital: Ratings derive from platform records and display in the worker interface.

why_ai: Separating careless workers from ambiguous items is a modelling problem over recorded answers.
why_clarity: Majority agreement is a weak truth signal on genuinely ambiguous items.
why_digital: Answers, attention checks and rejections are all platform data.

why_ai: Matching and alerting are solved problems in adjacent markets.
why_clarity: Search time saved and task acceptance are directly measurable.
why_digital: Task listings and worker searches happen entirely on the platform.

why_ai: Earnings and record tools derive from worker-accessible data, and the crowdwork itself is shrinking to AI.
why_clarity: Realised hourly rate and approval history are computable from timed task records.
why_digital: Remote global workers served through browser tools and platform data.

why_ai: Interpreting label disagreement is a modelling problem over data the requester already receives.
why_clarity: One-off batches by non-specialists, with no ground truth for whether labels are right.
why_digital: Results files and agreement statistics are delivered and analysed on screen.

why_ai: Adversarial bots and generated text evolve constantly, but the controls themselves are automated.
why_clarity: False positives against honest workers are hard to confirm without ground truth.
why_digital: Fingerprinting, duplicate detection and screening all run on submission data.
